I'd be keen to see a mini-deck with a new piece of equipment for each Hero:  something that you could just drop into each deck and leave there, but with an expansion symbol to signify that it's not part of the core deck.

Some ideas, perhaps:

Bunker--Plasma Cannon--Power:  Discard 1 card.  Deal 1 target 5 Energy damage.

Expatriette--Carbine--Power:  Deal 1 target 2 projectile damage and draw a card.

Absolute Zero--Exhaust Ventilator--Each time you deal a target cold damage, that target also takes 1 fire damage.  Power:  Destroy this card.  Absolute Zero takes 4 cold damage.

Wraith--Escrima Sticks--Power:  Deal one target 2 melee damage and another player may draw a card.

Ra--Headpiece of the Sun--Reduce all damage Ra takes from villain targets by 1.

ChronoRanger--StimPatch--Power:  ChronoRanger and one other Hero Target regain 3 hit points.

Fixer--Sledgehammer-- +3 damage, Fixer may not draw cards during his Draw phase.

Nightmist--Chains of Carcosa--Power:  Discard one card.  Nightmist takes * damage, equal to the * of the discarded card.  Choose one non-character villain target.  That target is shuffled back into the villain deck.

Omnitron X--Temporal Locator Collar--Place this card in front of an ally.  At the start of OX's turn, that ally may either draw a card or use a power.  Discard this card if the person it is attached to takes 5 or more damage in a single turn.

Legacy--Paul's Lantern--Whenever you draw a card, one other Hero of your choice may draw a card as well.

Fanatic--St. Andrew's Scourge--Power:  Deal 1 target 1 melee damage.  Fanatic regains 2 hit points.

Haka--Hoeroa--Power:  Deal 1 target 5 projectile damage and discard this card.

just some ideas off the top of my head...

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Warlock, heres some feedback.

Bunkers card would severly devalue flak cannon. Id suggest a supporting type power instead of another damage power as bunkers main glaring weekness (that engine tried to address) was his support cappabilities.

Tachyon already does a lot of instances of small damage. Maybe changing it to straight 2 sonic would be nice especially against opponents who have DR who normally can shut her down early game.

Legacys Lantern. I like the theme of it. The idea is alright, but you could infinity loop yourself and draw your whole deck and would be way too powerful combined with heros like Visionary or Team Leader Tach. Maybe "at the end of your turn, one hero other than yourself may draw a card" would be much more palatlable in terms of power.

Giving fanatic the power to heal that much on a whim worries me and goes against her theme of burning bright and fast. She already has the highest theoretical hitpoints (assuming both aegis's are used). Maybe a oneshot that prevents her from taking damage for a turn? Called it "Declared Sanctuary" with artwork of her meditating in her belltower (did I remember that story bit right?).

Haka's extra damage is way too much. Maybe an additional 1 or 2. But 5? Good god man haha. He already has some massive blows, I doubt he needs another.

I don't hate Ra's card, but I fear giving him DR of anykind would make him too much of a juggernaut that cant be slowed down. Maybe a card that lets him deal irreducible damage for a turn? I could see that fitting very well within his deck.

Wraith having yet another way to draw seems reduntant since her deck searching is top notch in the game already, and Eye Piece is a stable in most games. I can't think of anything I'd give Wraith as she can do just about everything already at a high level. Thats a tough one. Maybe something like "martial arts master" where she redirects melee attacks or something? Im not sold on that idea either though.

Tempest. Already does massive damage when needed. Maybe augment it to "first time deals lightning damage, heal 1 HP". I picture him conjouring a big storm and the rain and whatnot is constantly refreshing him. Just a thought.

I like giving Visionary a little damage boost. But the extra card draw? May not be enough incentive for her to scrap the damage boost. Maybe retooling it to be like "power: search your deck for an ongoing card and put it on top of your deck. destroy this card", still keeping the third eye name.

Another module for AZ? Dont hate that idea either. Chains nicely with on use power with his other cards in play. Nice idea.

Expat having a card draw gun option is a nice suggestion, although I would suggest the draw not be automatic and as a "on hit" sort of effect. Maybe even reduce the damage to 1 as well but keep the auto draw. Something to think about.

A big slow sledge hammer would go against his theme of being a quick and agile martile artist. His art has him holding a broom, so maybe "Broomstick. Equipment tool limited. Whenever Fixer deals damage, destroy an enviroment card". This would give him some MUCH needed support options and keeps in line with his "bring what you need" attitude.

Very interesting Nightmist choice. Although there is very little drawback (if any to be honest) for such a powerful field control ability. Maybe consider discarding 4 (maybe even 5) cards to activate such an ability and forget the damage aspect. Taking damage does not phase her in the least. There needs to be a noticeable drawback.

The Fiddle is always a good choice. Im not sure about the 3 damage part, maybe consider 2, as that would be way too good considering what he can chain with it.

Chrono's stim pack, while a good idea, seems way too powerful. Like, WAY powerful. You turn him from a hootin tootin cowboy basically into a medic, potentially making the rest of his deck subpar. Why use any other power ever? Id consider rethinking this. He already has a healing bounty remember.

Omni X's collar is pretty freakin cool idea. Plus sesseptable to the damage like his other cards, I feel like this is a nice fit.

For Unity, see my OmniX comment, as it applies here as well. Cool concept.

Wow. What a great name for Scholars card based on what it does. Slow clap for you sir. That made my day. Letting him heal on enviro damage *could* potentially tip the scales and make him absolutly unstoppable. Maybe remove the healing aspect? Or replace it with a card draw instead. I like that idea better in a strange way.

 

Wow. Ok. Thats a lot of type.

Thanks for the feedback, Ax!

My thoughts with the Legacy lantern were that he'd only be able to grant the additional card a maximum of three times (skip power/play to draw twice, third draw from the Pillars of Hercules), and that's under ideal conditions.

For the Chalice, the advantage lies in the option.  Everyone at the table COULD use their Power to gain the hit points, at the cost of being able to deal damage.  

I'm still up in the air on Ra's card.  Both options are useful for him, giving new options, but they don't really fit his fire schtick much.  Ancient Egypt, sure, but not fire.  I'll toy with it...

My thought for Nightmist's card was to continue the Cthulhu theme; Carcosa features in several Mythos tales as the home of the Great Old One, Hastur.

I'm pretty sure that Construction Pylon has just "Equipment" on it.  I can double check in a little.

Oh, and I would assume that you'd put 2 of each card into a given deck.  Ease of printing, and pretty simple across the board to implement.

posts.name: Sefirit
posts.cooked:
I completely agree that most of these are not OP, just a few.  In fact I really like quite a few of these and feel they are just what that hero needs.  Overall I think the list is very well done.  I looked back over the list again and think I reacted to some based on similar powers that exist in game. 

 

For example Taser reduces damage by 2.  This really might not be that OP, but if you compare it to Hoist Chain, Stun Bolts, LN Rounds, CR's crossbow thing, pretty much anything that reduces damage they all reduce by 1.  I can see how you might be balancing this by its low damage output because may of those other can be buffed by other cards in the deck where as taser would really only be buffed by turret mode.  Still 2 DR is ridiculouly good especially against a boss that is mostly a single target fight ie not a lot of minions that do damage.

 

Tempests heal is not so OP as I initially thought.  Compared to the bounty that heals passively it isn't so different. 

 

I like Third Eye a lot for Visionary, so I guess its good, I just see so many combos with Twist that searching for it is great.  Then again with only a couple copies of this added into the deck I don't think its a problem so yeah, I like it.

 

I love the Expat cards, they seem like just what she needs but I don't think I would buff the damage again at 5 hp for the coat.

 

I agree with an earlier statment about the Nightmist's chains card.  Whats to keep her from just redirecting the damage and getting a play that completely removes something and does a bunch of damage to another target.   I guess to also redirect would take 4 cards out of her hand so it kind of becomes her big awesome attack but I think you follow it up with a use of her base power and only take two damage and have plenty of cards back.

 

CR's Stim patch, we have seen how big +1 damage can be, I think this might be ok if it only worked on him, particularly because that is kind of his thing.  Keep in mind that he is quite capable of putting out 5+ sources of damage in a round much of which is from card play or out of turn power use so a +1 for him is amazing.  Adding in another hero pushes it over the edge.

 

Temporal locator Collar suffers int he same way that Taser does in my mind.  It seems like Embolden but much better.  It offer the choice between a power and a card so thats a bonus, and you don't take any damage so bonus.  Of course you can lose it, but if you get two uses out of it, its better than most one shots in the game.  Also I don't see that kind of damage too often, especially on any character with defensive capabilities so it seems like it could easily last several turns with no penalty for its use.

 

For the Scholar card, someone already mentioned that could be like 10 cards in one turn if an environment hits all targets, so maybe a one per turn max would make it really nice.

 

The Quill, I'm not sure what to do about as far as balancing it.  As soon as I read it though I thought "Holy Crap thats abusable"

 

I like Fixer's cards, but how about one called "Black Belt" or maybe make it a scroll or something that says "At the start of your turn you may destroy a stlye, if you do search your deck for a style and put it into your hand."  Helps him with the idea of swapping stances fluidly but would still take your card play to do it.  Also eventually you might not have the style you want in your deck any more.

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
Wow, ask and ye shall receive, right?  Thanks for the thorough feedback!

I see exactly what you're saying with Taser.  I downshifted it to -1 damage dealt.

I also removed the extra damage buff on Expatriette's trenchcoat.  +1/-1 are pretty sizable as it is.

I adjusted the Decorative Throw Rug such that it only triggers once per turn.

Strangely enough, I'm okay with Nightmist being able to redirect that damage.  If she's got the cards in hand to fuel such an action, she certainly won't in a turn or two, even while using Investigate.  

My thought with CR's Stim-Patch was that he'd essentially start alternating turns:  one round of Stim-Patch to buff and heal, one round of other power to deal damage.  The bigger benefit is definitely the damage buff, but the 1 HP rider is a nice one.  What would you think about making the power affect CR OR a single other Hero, but gain 2 HP?  

Temporal Collar is almost word for word a version of ElectroDeployment Unit.  The only real difference is that it affects a player other than OX and it allows a Power use rather than a card play.  Is it the flexibility of handing it to anyone that makes it OP?  I'm not sure...

I altered the Quill such that both Ra and the target Hero would have to destroy an Ongoing.  That way, it limits the amount of times Ra could potentially use it...it'd essentially cost him both a Play and a Power to use (as he'd have to Play the Ongoing that gets trashed).  Powerful benefit, for a powerful cost.

I'd be tempted to toss Fixer something that alters his Styles, but I'm kind of loathe to impinge on Meditation.  Even still, it could be really neat to see him shifting...wait a second.  Go see "Screw-Stick" now... :D

posts.cooked:
If I could suggest one for Bunker that goes in a different direction:

Hard Light Interface: (Equipment, Limited)

Bunker may have multiple copies of the same "Mode" card in play at the same time.

At the start of his turn, Bunker deals himself 2 psychic damage or destroys this card.

When this card leaves play, destroy all mode cards.

 

Modes aren't Limited (as Fixed Point attests), and this way he can do some fun things with multiple copies of upgrade/recharge/turret.

He could become a massive defensive juggernaut with multiple recharge modes, but I think that is comparable to visionary's cocoon or Nightmist's Mist form.

Turret is the one that has the potential to be overpowering, but I think the only way to bypass the "can't play cards" restriction is with Omnitron X...

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked: I like the concept, but I worry about the complexity of it.  What happens when you have two Upgrade Modes out, and you play a Turret Mode?  Do both Upgrade Modes go away?  Does Hard Light Interface?  Does Bunker still take the 2 Psychic damage if he has 2 Recharge Modes out?  It seems like a lot of mess for minimal reward...

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
If you played a new mode, then the normal condtions would re-assert themselves, and you'd get rid of both (or all three) modes in play. He can only have multiple copies of the same mode card- new ones still destryo all other modes cards in play.

Hard light interface is equipment, so it would stick around.  

Recharge mode reduces damage, even damage dealt to self, so you'd reduce it...to nothing if you had plating and 1 recharge, or 2 recharges out.

If it was too little reward, then you could make it so that it instead said:

 

 

Bunker may have multiple copies of the same "Mode" card in play at the same time.

Bunker may always play a "Mode" card, enven when he would otherwise be prevented from playing cards

When this card leaves play, destroy all mode cards.

 

With this configuration, he could give himself extra turret modes- so if he had the powers out, he could start using more and more every turn, at progressively higher damage.  He only has three direct damage powers (Grenade, flak, and omni-cannon), so with all three turret modes out, he'd be able to:

Use flak at +3 damage

Use grendes at +3 damage

Use Omni-cannon at +3 damage

Use 2 other powers (so, both repair modules)

 

and to even do that would require a LOT of setup time and a very, very lucky hand/draw of the cards.

In addition, the ability to always play a mode, even when the environment/villain/whatever would prevent card plays would reflect his tactical flexibility and ability ot adjust to any situation.
